one_liner: Coda (Superhuman Docs) has a broad REST API v1 at coda.io/apis/v1 with an OpenAPI spec, personal API tokens, and an official vendor-hosted MCP server (OAuth2 PKCE or tokens); it looks buildable now.
auth_notes: REST API uses personal API tokens generated at coda.io/account. OAuth2 with PKCE is documented only for the MCP server (mcp:all scope), not for the REST API; the Pack SDK OAuth pages concern Packs connecting to other services. So OAUTH2 is not listed for the public REST API. Composio also lists API_KEY only. Whether the REST API accepts OAuth tokens is not settled by the pages.
access_notes: Pages show no plan gating on the main API; only the Admin API requires Enterprise. The 'Free and Paid Workspaces' section text is truncated, so free access is not directly confirmed. This is the most defensible value, with lower confidence.
blocker_notes: Rate limits are modest (writes 10 per 6s). The Admin API is Enterprise-only, though a core toolkit does not need it. Multi-user OAuth for the REST API is not documented in the supplied pages, so users would paste personal tokens.

evidence.quote: The Superhuman Docs API is a RESTful API that lets you programmatically interact with data in Superhuman Docs (formerly Coda)
This API uses a base path of https://coda.io/apis/v1 .
